questions.stem: All of the following statements about eradication programme are true except:

options.label: A
options.text: There is complete interruption of disease transmission in the entire area of the community

options.label: B
options.text: Eradication programme is over once the disease has been certified as having been eradicated

options.label: C
options.text: Case finding is of secondary importance

options.label: D
options.text: The objective is to eliminate the disease to the extent that no new case occurs in the future
